name: PullOpenMovements
description: Morning pull, step 2 (plan 04.11, part A): pulls Priority's unmatched customer movements into OpenMovements and replaces the snapshot of every customer the source returns (rows of that customer not returned are deleted; nothing points at a movement). Each row gets the real customer link (Customers.id by customerCode), customerCode, customerName, docType, docNumber, docDate, dueDate, dueMonth (YYYY-MM of dueDate), amount (+ debt / − credit), details, source, importBatchId, syncedAt. Priority is not connected yet: the source is a stub, so the action returns ok:false, reason "Priority sync not connected yet" and writes nothing; rewritten in the sync turn. An empty source never empties the table (reported as failed). Run again after the receipts run (09:00 / 10:00). dryRun (default true) only reports. Never writes to Priority or contacts anyone.

dryRun.description: Default true: only report what would be written

importBatchId.description: ImportBatches row of the run this pull belongs to (optional)
